results.title: Duo
results.overview: Exploring connection, place, and the magic of cold-water surfing on both sides of the lens, this is a glimpse into the partnership of surf photographer and surfer, husband and wife, Rory and Elle Sutherland.

results.title: Pro Casual
results.overview: An ode to surfing joy. Featuring Steph Gilmore, Caity Simmers, Bryce Young, Ryan Burch, Derrick Disney, Leah Dawson Lopez, Tosh Tudor and Jaleesa Vincent, charging waves from California to South Africa to Indonesia.

results.title: I Will Try to Find You in the New System
results.original_title: I Will Try to Find You in the New System
results.overview: Years after their friend Alex went missing, Chris and Giada have been receiving strange videos from someone claiming to be him, and saying he needs to be found.

results.title: Un espoir tangible d'aimer les filles
results.original_title: Un espoir tangible d'aimer les filles

results.title: Hooja och den sista resan
results.overview: Hooja and Mårdis are two upstanding men from the Malmfälten region with grand plans—and a complete lack of a sense of direction. Tasked with transporting the ashes of a relative’s deceased elkhound along the Torne River, they embark on a journey for which they are neither prepared nor fully grasp the magnitude: they are to discover the soul of the Torne Valley. In the back: an urn. In the front seat: two men doing their absolute best. Ahead of them: encounters with the very best the Torne Valley has to offer.

results.title: Kinder
results.overview: Tofino surfers Mathea and Sanoa Olin grew up chasing some of Canada’s finest cold water waves together. This short celebrates the different paths each has followed in their first cinematic reunion for the hard charging sisters since childhood.

results.title: Thread
results.overview: A thread. A yarn. A tale. A story to tell. A visual and sonic masterpiece journeying across the Celtic fringes, through thunderous barrels and peeling points breaks, pulling on threads that reveal that it’s as much about the journey as the folk that are with you along the way.

results.title: Dhana Dhanya Kalyana
results.overview: A feature-length observational documentary following Dhananjaya and Dhanyatha through an important chapter of their lives.  The wedding is part of the story, but not the whole of it. The film looks beyond the celebrations, into the everyday moments, relationships, decisions, and changes that make up a life together.

results.title: 5th Spring
results.overview: An intimate portrait of growing up, told in reverse chronology, gradually revealing how hidden past experiences shape a person's emotions, relationships, and life choices.

results.title: Captain Jack, the Pirate Cat of Hatter's Hall
results.original_title: Captain Jack, the Pirate Cat of Hatter's Hall
results.overview: He’s a sassy old cat who sits in the sun outside a second-hand record shop, but it might surprise you to find out about his past, and about just how special he is to the people who come and visit him.

results.title: Earthbeat
results.overview: A nature recordist’s microphone becomes a lifeline to the wild, capturing echoes of a world that is struggling to be heard.

results.title: Trop Humaine
results.overview: For year she held on to what she believed was the right way to care for her patients, despite the hospital’s dehumanization, until the night that was one too many.

results.title: The Kingdom of Cream and Glass
results.original_title: The Kingdom of Cream and Glass
results.overview: Film student Matt Newsom spends the summer of 2026 doing god knows what and records all of it for some reason

results.title: Salzwasser
results.overview: When his father cries in front of him for the first time, Jona doesn’t know what to do. He leaves the house and enters the dark. He wanders through the woods with a torch, down to the water. A film about the attempt to put feelings into words and about all that remains unsaid between fathers and sons.
